name: inw_p
description: inw_p performs a word-width (16-bit) input from the specified I/O port and pauses until the I/O operation completes. It is used for low-level hardware port access and is primarily intended for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port address to read from.

return_value.success: Returns the unsigned short value read from the port
return_value.failure: May result in a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not properly set

bugs: Requires compilation with optimization flags such as -O or -O2, as the functions are defined as inline macros that may cause unresolved references without optimization; also requires ioperm(2) or iopl(2) for I/O port access permissions.
